evaluation_cost_scope: one synchronized predict_case call per matched case; excludes dataset I/O, checkpoint loading, metrics, and plotting
physical_error_space: dataset-native units per field/interface/port quantity; no mixed-unit cross-channel physical aggregate

fixed_physical_probe_definitions.pressure_drop: mean pressure on the 64 fixed fluid-grid coordinates at x=min(x_grid) minus the mean on the 64 fixed fluid-grid coordinates at x=max(x_grid); the difference is pressure-gauge invariant
fixed_physical_probe_definitions.mean_outlet_temperature: mean temperature on the same 64 fixed fluid-grid coordinates at x=max(x_grid)
fixed_physical_probe_definitions.module_temperature_kpi: mean predicted internal temperature over every sampled internal cell of every active module; stable within a fixed case, not an identity-matched KPI across different module counts

physical_stratum_definitions.spacing: minimum module-surface gap divided by radius: <1, 1-2.5, >=2.5
physical_stratum_definitions.wall_proximity: minimum module-surface wall clearance divided by radius: <1.5, 1.5-2.5, >=2.5
